Title: Mastering Error-Free Work — Practical Methods Based on Cognitive Science

Instructor: Masami Utsuide (Human development specialist, systems auditor, certified public accountant)

Format: Web seminar (46 minutes)

Content: Relying only on individual attention and experience cannot prevent work errors. Using cognitive science, we'll uncover why people make mistakes and introduce concrete prevention strategies you can implement right away in your workplace. Improve your work performance through a scientific approach.

How to watch: Click the QR code on PC, or scan the QR code with your smartphone to access

Target audience: Member businesses of Hanno Chamber of Commerce and Industry

Application: Member businesses should contact their representative to request ID/password issuance.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2637/
